RunSynchronousCommand.Path: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$log = Join-Path $env:windir 'Temp\Pi4Disable3GB.log'; try { $c = @((Join-Path $env:windir 'Setup\Scripts\Pi4Disable3GB.ps1')) + (Get-PSDrive -PSProvider FileSystem | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $_.Root 'Pi4Disable3GB.ps1' }); $s = $c | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($s) { & $s; Set-Content $log ('ran ' + $s) } else { Set-Content $log ('not found: ' + ($c -join ', ')) } } catch { Set-Content $log ('failed: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; exit 0"
